plainTranslation: Person A (Mars)'s wish to act can stand in contrast to Person B (Saturn)'s insistence on timing, preparation or responsibility. Person A (Mars) may feel prevented from acting on an intention, while Person B (Saturn) may feel that legitimate concerns are being overridden. Person A (Mars)'s stronger assertion can provoke more restraint from Person B (Saturn); Person B (Saturn)'s firmer conditions can make Person A (Mars) more determined to act independently. The opposition can bring the disagreement over authority and pace into focus, with prolonged frustration potentially reducing goodwill. Both people's intentions and the rest of their charts matter. This is not evidence that one is inherently reckless, that the other is always controlling or that the relationship has an inevitable outcome.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their limits and your drive grind against each other. You feel blocked, and they feel rushed. Agree on the pace out loud.
tension: The challenge is that you want to move and they keep hitting the brakes. You get frustrated because everything feels harder than it needs to be. They get frustrated because you seem reckless or impatient. If neither of you adjusts, the relationship turns into a constant fight between action and resistance. At that point, the issue is no longer the goal itself but the struggle over how it should be pursued.
advice: This connection works best when both people recognize that passion and discipline serve different purposes. Desire provides the motivation to move forward. Wisdom helps determine how and when to act. When those forces work together, the relationship can accomplish far more than either could alone. Meet in the middle; you each hold what the other lacks.
summaryShort: Their limits and your drive grind against each other.
